functional_reading.detector_event: The observed detector rise was 3.121260831 ms after injection, outside the declared 2 ms window. The run therefore does not establish detector timing or causal fault recognition; the late edge mechanism is unproven.
functional_reading.healthy_mos_scope: DIODE-SHORT leaves Msw gate-controlled. It shorts one modeled diode-side terminal path sw to vd; this is distinct from SW-SHORT/BOTH-SHORT, where a gate-independent sw-to-channel_source branch defeats gate control.
functional_reading.source_and_storage: Bridge/source -> Lboost -> sw is the source-fed path. VD has 19.8 uF Clocal. VB has 2240 uF Cbank and connects to VD through normally closed modeled F2 (Vf2ctl=5 V). F2 is held closed in this case. These are connectivity facts, not measured physical energy or interruption claims.

detector_model.sensed_nodes: protection.inc forms VD/VB divider comparisons (ch_vd and ch_vb), plus forward/reverse divider comparisons, then ORs them into fault_raw.
detector_model.qualification: fault_raw is RC-filtered, health requires fault below threshold plus rails/permit/fast-good/logic conditions, and clear resets the latch when health or logic5 is low.
detector_model.limits: The model does not prove that the late detector edge was caused by a particular divider, diode current, or bank discharge. A future strategy needs per-comparator timing and node-voltage evidence in the declared event window.

isense.path: Risense is between bridge_minus and isense; UCC28180 receives isense. It is source/bridge-side current-loop instrumentation in this deck.
isense.bank_discharge: ISENSE does not necessarily see all Cbank/Clocal discharge current. A local VB->F2->VD/diode/short loop can circulate without traversing bridge_minus; whether any portion returns through the mains path depends on instantaneous switch states and network impedances. The deck does not justify assuming equivalence.

future_requirements: Align detector timing to the actual fault edge and retain each VD/VB/fwd/rev comparator input and fault_raw transition with sub-window timing.
Measure source/bridge current, VDS/switch-node current, VD current, VB/F2 current, and local capacitor voltages as separate channels; do not use ISENSE as a bank-discharge proxy.
Bound stored energy and residual discharge paths for Cbank, Clocal, and any modeled diode/short path before selecting or qualifying an interrupter.
Keep DIODE-SHORT healthy-MOS conclusions separate from failed-MOS SW-SHORT/BOTH-SHORT requirements for a gate-independent source-fed branch and restart behavior.
Use the same source/tool hashes and independent prefix/phase/endpoint/event receipts; do not infer a causal mechanism from this late detector edge.
